question: If 4 tan θ = 3, then (4 sin θ-cos θ+1)/(4 sin θ+cos θ-1)= _________.
solution:
**Given:**

4 tan θ = 3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8447d99c840d43862d7dcc7d1b78a458f75c7e95e40f216373f463a13248e1d9.png] 

Applying Pythagoras Theorem

AC² = AB² + BC²

AC² = 3² + 4²

AC = 5

sinθ = 3/5

cosθ =4/5

(4 sin θ-cos θ+1)/(4 sin θ+cos θ-1)
